_readme: Your numbers, not ours: every value ships null and a null check is skipped (AUDIT.md lists it as 'threshold not set, skipped'). Copy to thresholds.json and fill each from your own last 90 days (Ads Manager, ad level, date range = last 90 days, columns: amount spent, leads, cost per lead, link CTR, frequency, 3-second video plays, impressions) plus your unit economics. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

_how_to_set.target_cpl: The CPL you can afford: work back from what a customer is worth (first payment x margin x lead-to-customer rate), or use your median ad-level CPL over 90 days if that already pays back.
_how_to_set.kill_cpl_multiple: Look at ads that eventually got leads: how much had they spent, as a multiple of target CPL, when the first lead came? Pick a multiple above most of them so you rarely kill a late starter.
_how_to_set.min_spend_no_target: Only used while target_cpl is null: a spend amount in account currency after which a zero-lead ad is worth a look (for example your 90-day median spend per first lead).
_how_to_set.kill_ctr_below_pct: Link CTR (%) of your bottom quarter of ads over 90 days; a zero-lead ad below it is weak on leading indicators too.
_how_to_set.hook_rate_floor_pct: 3-second video plays / impressions x 100 per video ad over 90 days; use the bottom-quarter value as the floor.
_how_to_set.frequency_ceiling_local: Local mode: the 7-day frequency at which your past local campaigns' cost per lead started climbing.
_how_to_set.max_radius_miles_local: Local mode: the distance (miles) that covers most of your existing customers' home postcodes / zip codes.
_how_to_set.min_ads_per_adset: The fewest genuinely different concepts you are willing to launch an ad set with (below it = P1).
_how_to_set.target_ads_per_adset: How many distinct concepts you aim to have live per ad set once running (below it = P2). Scale it with budget.
_how_to_set.min_daily_budget_per_ad: Daily budget per ad (account currency) below which ads in your account rarely got enough delivery to judge in a week: check ads with fewer than a few leads after 7 days and their daily spend.
